title: Yatta's Crazy Gui
features: script contains an autofarm, along with other stuff.

comments.text: One of the best scripts I've used for Dandy's World. However, if you enable "Instant Skillcheck," you won't be able to complete the Barnaby machines. Even disabling it won't fix it. Because of that, you can't progress further. I hope this can be changed.
a REALLY good script!! def reccommend

comments.text: @fishadopter It appears my executor was the problem—xeno. i have switched to a more capable executor and everything seems fine now. sorry for the inconvenience. (before, the barnaby machines couldn't be used at all if auto skillcheck was enabled, so it'd softlock you and make you stuck forever on whatever floor you were on)
